welcome.title: Welcome to {{brand}}
welcome.body: Trade CFDs on forex, gold, indices, oil and crypto with USDT. Two steps before your first trade:
items: Deposit USDT (trade as soon as it arrives)
welcome.note: You can open this guide again from Me → Getting started.

kyc.title: Step 1: verify your identity
kyc.body: Upload photos of your ID. Your name and date of birth must match it. Reviews usually finish within one business day; the result is sent to your inbox and email.
items: Both sides of your ID card, or the photo page of your passport
kyc.note: Once verified, deposits, trading and withdrawals are all available. Withdrawals require verification.

deposit.title: Step 2: deposit USDT
deposit.body: Go to Assets → Deposit, choose a network, copy your own address and send USDT from an exchange or wallet.
items: Ethereum (ERC20), TRON (TRC20) and BNB Chain are supported
Your balance updates automatically and you get a notification
deposit.note: Send USDT only, on the same network as the address. Wrong coins or networks cannot be recovered.

trade.title: Finally: your first order
trade.body: On the Trade page pick a symbol, set lots and leverage, then press "Confirm buy / Confirm sell" at the bottom of the order panel.
items: Isolated margin: a position can lose at most its own margin
Set take profit and stop loss to close automatically
trade.note: CFDs are leveraged; you can lose all of your margin.

records.title: Fund records
records.note: Times are shown in your local time zone, to the second. Records are kept permanently and cannot be deleted. Transfers below 1 USDT are not credited and do not appear here.

Go back to the Telegram bot, tap "Re-authorize", then "Open trading".
reason.continue: Tap below to go back to the bot, then tap the "Enter trading ›" button in the latest message. If you use the web at least once every 7 days, the bot buttons open it directly.

tg.recoverSteps: Recovery (moving the account to a new Telegram) is requested in the bot only: open the bot with your new Telegram, tap "Recover my account" and send your customer number, your name as verified, and the last 4 characters of your ID number. The current holder is notified; after a 48-hour objection period a reviewer verifies you by video, and an approved request runs 24 hours later. Support will never DM you for passwords or codes.

tg.recoverNoBot: The bot link is unavailable. Search for our bot in Telegram and send /recover.

Only one device stays signed in this way: signing in here signs out your other devices.

pin.title: Withdrawal PIN
pin.note: Digit positions change every time. We will never ask you to type your withdrawal PIN.
pin.rule: After setting or changing it, all web sessions of this account are signed out and withdrawals pause for 24 hours.
pin.ruleReset: After resetting, all web sessions are signed out and withdrawals pause for 48 hours. Whitelist addresses are kept.
pin.setIntro: Telegram accounts need a withdrawal PIN to add whitelist addresses and withdraw. Choose 6 digits only you know.
pin.whitelistLabel: Withdrawal PIN (needed to add an address)
pin.manualIntro: No email linked: a forgotten PIN needs a manual reset. A reviewer will contact you on Telegram for a video check of your identity and source of funds. Once approved it takes effect after 48 hours: the old PIN stops working, the whitelist is cleared and withdrawals pause for 48 hours.
pin.manualDone: Submitted (request #{{id}}). You can view or cancel it under Recovery requests.

recovery.title: Recovery requests
recovery.intro: Requests to recover (rebind) your account, or your own manual PIN reset requests.
recovery.disputed: You tapped "Not me": strict manual review
recovery.frozen: Withdrawals frozen until the review is done
recovery.revokeRequested: Cancellation requested; the reviewer will decide
recovery.pinLabel: Enter your withdrawal PIN (correct PIN = no freeze)
recovery.pinOkDone: Confirmed: withdrawals are not frozen. The request still goes to strict manual review.
recovery.revokeBody: Manual PIN reset: cancelled immediately. Rebind: during the objection period it counts as "Not me"; after that, every cancellation goes to the reviewer, who verifies by video and decides. Nothing runs before that, and the withdrawal freeze stays.

freeze.intro: Use this if your account may be stolen or you lost your Telegram: enter your customer number and one detail only you know. Withdrawals, adding addresses and PIN changes stop; trading continues. Only a manual check can lift it.
freeze.name: Name as verified
freeze.hardHint: Many failed attempts from this device; the captcha is harder now.
freeze.after: If the details are correct, withdrawals are now frozen and the account holder is notified. Lifting it needs a manual identity check (within 1 business day); contact support.
freeze.title: Withdrawal freezes
freeze.manualOnly: Some freezes can only be lifted manually. Contact support for an identity check.
freeze.selfIntro: You set this freeze in the bot. Enter your withdrawal PIN and it lifts automatically after 24 hours (Telegram and email are notified). If someone requests a freeze on the web meanwhile, it turns manual.
